```{r}
#| include: false
MCERIDHadTarget <- exists("ID.target", inherits = FALSE)
MCERIDTarget <- .currentTarget("ID.target")
MCERIDRequest <- MCERIDTarget
if (!length(MCERIDRequest)) MCERIDRequest <- .currentTarget("ID.gmdp")
ID.target <- .resolveIDTarget(
  ASCETable,
  "MCER table",
  base = TRUE,
  target = MCERIDRequest,
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
Vs30.target <- Vs30.gmdp
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- readCaption("tbl.MCER")
```
